byteblob.concept: Boxy robot-slime with a black visor screen for a face, stubby legs, bent antenna with a yellow tip.

patchfox.concept: Standing fox critter with huge triangle ears, white-tipped bushy tail and a blue chest patch.

nullgeist.concept: Hooded sheet-ghost with a jagged hem, one glowing cyan eye and one magenta X eye.

kernelcrab.concept: Wide low crab with raised claws, stalk eyes and a chip-shaped shell.

cachebat.concept: Hovering bat with huge jagged wings, pink ears, fangs and yellow eyes.

stacktoise.concept: Upright tortoise whose shell is a stack of three server racks with amber LEDs.

daemowl.concept: Chubby three-eyed horned owl with giant amber eyes (third eye on the forehead) and a lightning bolt on its chest.

shellsnail.concept: Snail carrying a retro terminal as its shell, with a prompt on the screen.

regexopus.concept: Round-headed octopus with six curling tentacles and asterisk spots.

firewyrm.concept: Upright baby dragon with horns, stubby wings, a curled tail and a flame puff.
